definition: Velvet AI is a family of multilingual generative artificial intelligence models developed by Almawave, an Italian AI company.
details: The Velvet models, including Velvet 14B and Velvet 2B, are foundational large language models (LLMs) designed and developed in Italy on Almawave's proprietary architecture. They were trained on the Leonardo supercomputer managed by CINECA and have been released in open-weight format. The Velvet models are designed to be energy-efficient. They support multiple languages, with an emphasis on Italian.

explainer.lead: Velvet AI is a family of multilingual generative AI models from the Italian company Almawave. It matters as a European, open-weight LLM option with an emphasis on Italian.

tiers.eli5: An Italian-made language model family, like a local brand of a product most people only know from abroad.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers can use the open-weight Velvet models, including Velvet 14B and Velvet 2B, for multilingual tasks with a focus on Italian. A pitfall is assuming broad language coverage beyond the emphasized Italian support.
tiers.paperLevel: Foundational LLMs built on Almawave's proprietary architecture, trained on the Leonardo supercomputer managed by CINECA, released in open-weight format and designed for energy efficiency. Specific benchmark limits are not stated.

explainer.example: A team building an Italian-language assistant picks Velvet 2B for a lightweight deployment and Velvet 14B where more capacity is needed.
